pages.title: Onboarding
pages.body: Onboarding a teammate in this knowledge space: create the personal tenant, install WikiSkill, then run the first objective. See Artifacts for deliverable format.

pages.title: Artifacts
pages.body: Artifacts in this knowledge space are versioned source files: documents, spreadsheets and slides. Format validation blocks completion. Provenance links back to the producing run.

pages.title: Policy
pages.body: Capability only narrows in this knowledge space. Skills cannot grant permissions. Policy deny wins over ask and always.

pages.title: Search index
pages.body: The typed SearchProgram in this knowledge space addresses exact, lexical, semantic, graph, history and memory channels. Predicates are a closed vocabulary. No free-form query strings.

pages.title: Teammates
pages.body: A teammate in this knowledge space is a standing instruction plus a mailbox. Archiving keeps lineage; it does not invent a second agent runtime.

pages.title: Retired onboarding notes
pages.body: This retired onboarding page must not answer retrieval even if the query says onboarding.
